difficult behaviors of an infant are associated with the psychosocial environment of the parents and that this association is especially strong at the beginning of the infant's life.

early identification of difficult behaviors in an infant and the implementation of appropriate interventions can be helpful to prevent the continuation of difficult behaviors and to reduce the risk of mental health problems in the later stages of development.
